label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Send plain-text emails sometimes.
body: Occasionally sending simple, text-only emails can feel more personal and less like a sales pitch, cutting through the noise.
caption:
While beautiful designs have their place, a simple plain-text email can often feel more direct and personal, like a note from a friend. It's quick to load, works on every device, and makes your message stand out in a busy inbox. Try using it for quick updates, personal check-ins, or when you want your core message to shine without distractions. See how your audience responds!
